test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the given sentence, one word may have been incorrectly spelt. Select the correctly spelt word from the given alternatives. If there is no error, select ‘No error’ as your answer.

The erroneous information spread rapidly across the nation and created a stir.
solution:
The correct answer is: **No error**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling is 'erroneous'.
 
• No other option defines the correct spelling of 'erroneous'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **No error**.
